summary: The HIR printer emits empty Unicode and byte character classes as [] and (?-u:[]), which cannot be parsed because the initial ] is interpreted literally, leaving the class unclosed. The fix prints [a&&b], a valid empty intersection, for both cases. The fix extends the existing print_class test with empty classes; its roundtrip helper re-parses the printed output. The reversal removes only the two implementation guards. Both source regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were executed.
